ns2:course.label: Intermediate Bamana I
ns2:course.description: Survey of more advanced grammar, with emphasis on increasing conversational fluency, compositional skills, study of written texts in standard Bamana, and discussion of grammatical variations. Participation in the language laboratory may be required. Same as AFST 403. Summer 2008: 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Fall 2008 4 hours only. Prerequisite: BMNA 202.
